fieldData.acrm---key-feature-5-content:
Emails that reach the right esthetician

Pick the answers that should reach a person, such as a client asking for a call. The app emails the esthetician on the booking, and the reply lands on the consent record.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
When Nadira asks for a call on day 3, Faustine gets an email

Three days after her peel at Halcyon Aesthetics, Nadira Sefton gets a 3-question check-in email. She answers yes to a call from her esthetician. Faustine Delacey gets an email that says Nadira asked for a call, and the check-in answers save to Nadira's consent record.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { peelSeries: "I run Briarcliff Skin Studio. Build a chemical peel consent form for clients who buy a series of 6 peels. At visit 1 they sign the full form. Before each later visit, send a link with 2 questions: has anything changed since the last peel, and do they still agree to the signed terms. Save each answer and signature on the same client record with the visit number, such as visit 3 of 6.", threeLocations: "Fernwell Med Spa has 3 locations: Riverside, Northgate, and Elm Street. Build one chemical peel consent form whose first question asks the client which location they are visiting. Give each location manager a screen that lists the forms signed at their location this week, with the total across all 3 locations at the top.", day3CheckIn: "Build a chemical peel consent form for Halcyon Aesthetics that also sends each client a 3-question check-in email 3 days after their peel. If the client answers yes to a call from their esthetician, email that esthetician with the client's name. Save the check-in answers to the client's consent record.", lobbyTablet: "Celandine Skin Bar keeps a tablet in the lobby for clients who arrive without a signed consent form. Build a chemical peel consent form for that tablet. After each signature, clear the answers and open a blank form for the next client. Give the front desk a list of today's clients showing who has signed." };
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-4-des: Type the questions your provider wants answered before a peel, and mark each one required. Choose which answers should email the esthetician on the booking.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: Nadira Sefton answers a 3-question check-in 3 days after her peel at Halcyon Aesthetics, and esthetician Faustine Delacey gets an email saying Nadira asked for a call.

fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Three providers, each in a row of its own

A neighbor's dog bites Corentin Malabey on the forearm. He lists 3 providers: Eastgate Urgent Care, plastic surgeon Dr. Leonie Farquhar, and Stillwater Physical Therapy, each with a first visit date and a phone number. Paralegal Ysolde Partridge gets an email with all 3 rows and starts the records requests from those rows.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
After the last answer, a signature at 9:42 p.m.

A turning van knocks Oyelaran Fitch off her bike, and she fills in the intake on her phone that night, one question per screen. On the last screen she signs a statement that her answers are true. Intake coordinator Bram Kettleworth gets an email showing the signature saved beside her answers, with the time: 9:42 p.m.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { carAccidents: "Build a personal injury intake form for my firm's car accident cases. Ask for the other driver's name, their insurer, and the police report number. Compare the other driver's name with our client list. If it matches, hold the intake and email our conflicts coordinator, Imelda Ostrander, before any attorney sees it.", slipAndFall: "Build an intake form for slip and fall cases. Ask for the store's name, the aisle, what was on the floor, and the incident report number the store gave. Let the person upload photos from their phone, and keep every photo with the intake record so our attorney opens them there.", dogBites: "Build an intake form for dog bite cases. Ask for the dog owner's name and address, where the bite happened, and every doctor, clinic, or therapist the person has seen since. Give each provider its own row with a first visit date and a phone number, then email the list to our paralegal, Ysolde Partridge.", bicycleCrashes: "Build a phone-friendly intake form for bicycle crash cases that shows one question per screen. Ask what hit the rider, where, and when. On the last screen, have the person sign a statement that their answers are true, then email our intake coordinator the signature and the time it was signed." };
fieldData.afb---how-to-step-6-des: Decide which intakes reach whom: a name match goes to the person who clears conflicts, a provider list to the paralegal, and everything else to the intake queue. Pick email, Slack, or an in-app alert for each one.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: Corentin Malabey's dog bite intake lists 3 providers, Eastgate Urgent Care, Dr. Leonie Farquhar, and Stillwater Physical Therapy, each in its own row with a first visit date and a phone number; paralegal Ysolde Partridge gets an email with the list.

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: Oyelaran Fitch answers a bicycle crash intake one question per screen on her phone and signs on the last screen that her answers are true; intake coordinator Bram Kettleworth gets an email showing the signature was saved at 9:42 p.m.
